about: The classes, methods and constants of the public PHP API of the Nextcloud server, with the majors that have each and those that deprecate it, generated by data/update/nextcloud-ocp.py from the sources it names. Not edited by hand.

PROPERTY_DISPLAYNAME_LEGACY: only added for backwards compatibility with provisioning_api UsersController::getCurrentUser

publishActivity: Grab an IEvent from generateEvent() instead and use the publish() method

addNavigationEntry: Use \OC::$server->getNavigationManager()->add() instead to register a closure, this helps to speed up all requests against ownCloud
checkAppEnabled: ownCloud core will handle disabled apps and redirects to valid URLs
registerAdmin: Use settings section in appinfo.xml to register admin sections
registerPersonal: Use settings section in appinfo.xml to register personal admin sections

registerRoutes: Just return an array from your routes.php

deprecated: Use OpenAPI with OpenAPI::SCOPE_IGNORE instead: `#[OpenAPI(scope: OpenAPI::SCOPE_IGNORE)]`
Use one of our stricter CSP policies

allowEvalScript: Eval should not be used anymore. Please update your scripts. This function will stop functioning in a future version of Nextcloud.

__construct: To implement an OCS endpoint extend the OCSController
render: To implement an OCS endpoint extend the OCSController

deprecated: To implement an OCS endpoint extend the OCSController

add3rdPartyScript: include javascript and css in template files shorthand for addScript for files in the 3rdparty directory
add3rdPartyStyle: include javascript and css in template files shorthand for addStyle for files in the 3rdparty directory
addScript: include javascript and css in template files
addStyle: include javascript and css in template files
isAppEnabled: communication between apps should happen over built in callbacks or interfaces (check the contacts and calendar managers) Checks if an app is enabled also use \OC::$server->getAppManager()->isEnabledForUser($appName)

getParameters: this method is only used internally
getType: this method is only used internally
hasAnnotation: will be obsolete with native attributes in PHP8
reflect: Reflect should not be called multiple times and only be used internally. This will be removed in Nextcloud 18

deprecated: will be obsolete with native attributes in PHP8
Use AppEnabledEvent, AppDisableEvent and AppUpdateEvent instead

execute: Use start() instead. This method will be removed with the ILogger interface

getAll: This method is dangerous since it can cause load and memory problems when creating too many instances. Use getJobs instead.
getJobs: Use getJobsIterator instead to avoid duplicated job objects
getLastJob: The functionality behind the value is deprecated, it only tells you which job finished last, but since we now allow multiple executors to run in parallel, it's not used to calculate the next job.

execute: Use start() instead. This method will be removed with the ILogger interface
Use start() instead. This method will be removed with the ILogger interface

deprecated: The interface is considered internal going forward and should not be implemented by apps anymore
The interface is considered internal going forward and should not be implemented by apps anymore

EVENT_ENTITY: Listen to the typed event instead.

getEvent: Use instanceof CommentAddedEvent, CommentRemovedEvent, CommentUpdatedEvent or BeforeCommentUpdatedEvent instead.

handle: Register a listener for the CommentsEvent through the IEventDispatcher

deprecated: Register a listener for the CommentsEvent through the IEventDispatcher

deleteSystemValue: use method deleteSystemValue of \OCP\IConfig  This function deletes the value from config.php.
getAppValue: use method getAppValue of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets a value from the appconfig table. If the key does not exist the default value will be returned
getSystemValue: use method getSystemValue of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets the value from config.php. If it does not exist, $default will be returned.
getUserValue: use method getUserValue of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets a value from the preferences table. If the key does not exist the default value will be returned
setAppValue: use method setAppValue of \OCP\IConfig  Sets a value. If the key did not exist before it will be created.
setSystemValue: use method setSystemValue of \OCP\IConfig  This function sets the value and writes the config.php. If the file can not be written, false will be returned.
setUserValue: use method setUserValue of \OCP\IConfig  Adds a value to the preferences. If the key did not exist before, it will be added automagically.

isError: Doctrine returns false on error (and throws an exception)

md5: MD5 is not considered secure anymore, thus most databases have or will drop support for this function

PARAM_JSON: JSON fields can not properly be used in WHERE statements of Oracle and MySQL. It is recommended to use a simple STRING field and handle JSON within PHP
getQueryPart: This function is going to be removed with the next Doctrine/DBAL update and we can not fix this in our wrapper. Please track the details you need, outside the object.
getQueryParts: This function is going to be removed with the next Doctrine/DBAL update and we can not fix this in our wrapper. Please track the details you need, outside the object.
getState: This function is going to be removed with the next Doctrine/DBAL update and we can not fix this in our wrapper.
resetQueryPart: This function is going to be removed with the next Doctrine/DBAL update and we can not fix this in our wrapper. Please create a new IQueryBuilder instead.
resetQueryParts: This function is going to be removed with the next Doctrine/DBAL update and we can not fix this in our wrapper. Please create a new IQueryBuilder instead.

JSON: JSON fields can not properly be used in WHERE statements of Oracle and MySQL. It is recommended to use a simple STRING field and handle JSON within PHP

sendNotification: Use sendCloudNotification() instead and handle errors manually
sendShare: Use sendCloudShare() instead and handle errors manually

buildNotExistingFileName: use getNonExistingName of the OCP\Files\Folder object

search: due to lack of pagination, not all backends might implement this
searchByMime: due to lack of pagination, not all backends might implement this
searchByTag: due to lack of pagination, not all backends might implement this

getDirectory: Use getFolder instead and use node API

usersInGroup: Use searchInGroup instead, for performance reasons

deprecated: it can't be guaranteed that this event is triggered in all case (e.g. for LDAP users this isn't possible) - if there is a valid use case please reach out in the issue tracker at https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues

deleteApp: use method deleteAppValue of \OCP\IConfig  Removes all keys in appconfig belonging to the app.
getKeys: use method getAppKeys of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets all keys of an app. Please note that the values are not returned.
getValue: use method getAppValue of \OCP\IConfig  This function gets a value from the appconfig table. If the key does not exist the default value will be returned
setValue: use method setAppValue of \OCP\IConfig  Sets a value. If the key did not exist before it will be created.

hasKey: Directly read from GET to prevent race conditions

create: Use either createLocking, createDistributed or createLocal

ADD_MISSING_INDEXES_EVENT: this is an internal event, use AddMissingIndicesEvent instead
CHECK_MISSING_INDEXES_EVENT: this is an internal event, use AddMissingIndicesEvent instead
getDatabasePlatform: Please use self::getDatabaseProvider() and compare to self::PLATFORM_* constants
insertIfNotExist: use unique index and "try { $db->insert() } catch (\OCP\DB\Exception $e) { if ($e->getReason() === \OCP\DB\Exception::REASON_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION) {} }" instead, because it is more reliable and does not have the risk for deadlocks - see https://github.com/nextcloud/server/pull/12371

logException: use the `exception` entry in the context of any method in \Psr\Log\LoggerInterface

registerProvider: Register your provider via the IRegistrationContext when booting the app

search: use searchPaged() with page and size
